intro.title: Lapis Lazuli Shree Yantra
intro.descriptionHtml: Explore our Premium Collection of 3D Meru Lapis Lazuli Shree Yantras, crafted from Natural, Unheated Lapis Lazuli. Each handmade Sri Chakra Yantra is carved from a single stone, featuring Accurate Sacred Geometry, Intricate Detailing & Exceptional Craftsmanship, in different sizes and designs. Made from premium-grade Lapis Lazuli in royal blue with natural golden flecks, each piece reflects superior quality and precision. Ideal for awakening wisdom, strengthening truthful speech, and building confidence, while inviting clarity, protection, and abundance.
